questions.stem: Which sentence is in the Present Continuous tense?
questions.explanation: Present Continuous = am/is/are + verb-ing. 'She is playing tennis now.'

questions.stem: What is the past tense of 'go'?
questions.explanation: 'Go' is an irregular verb. Its past tense is 'went'.

questions.stem: Read: 'Sara is taller than Ali, but shorter than Zeynep.' Who is the tallest?
questions.explanation: Zeynep is taller than Sara, who is taller than Ali. Zeynep is the tallest.

questions.stem: Which is the correct comparative form of 'big'?
questions.explanation: Short adjectives form comparatives by adding -er: big → bigger (double the final consonant).

questions.stem: Yesterday, Ali ___ his homework after dinner.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' signals past tense. 'Did' is the past form of 'do'.

questions.stem: What does 'environment' mean in Turkish?
questions.explanation: 'Environment' = 'çevre' in Turkish – the natural world around us.

questions.stem: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanation: Present Continuous: Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing. 'I am going to school.'

questions.stem: Which is the superlative form of 'good'?
questions.explanation: 'Good' has an irregular superlative: 'best'. 'Better' is the comparative.

questions.stem: Zeynep has technology that connects her to the internet anywhere. What does she have?
questions.explanation: A smartphone connects to the internet wirelessly anywhere.

questions.stem: What is the negative form of 'She visited the museum'?
questions.explanation: Past simple negative: didn't + base verb. 'She didn't visit the museum.'

questions.stem: Which sentence uses 'was' correctly?
questions.explanation: 'Was' is used with I, he, she, it. 'I was happy' is correct.

questions.stem: Which word means something that is very good for your health?
questions.explanation: 'Healthy' describes things that are good for your body and health.

questions.stem: Complete: 'This is ___ book I have ever read.'
questions.explanation: Superlatives use 'the + most + adjective': 'the most interesting'.

questions.stem: Translate: 'Dün sabah okula gitmedi.'
options: She doesn't go to school this morning.
She didn't go to school yesterday morning.
She went to school yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: 'Dün sabah' = 'yesterday morning'; 'gitmedi' = 'didn't go'.

questions.stem: Which sentence is a question in Past Simple?
questions.explanation: Past Simple questions: Did + subject + base verb? 'Did you eat breakfast?'

questions.stem: The Amazon is ___ river in the world.
questions.explanation: To express the highest degree among all, we use 'the + superlative'.

questions.stem: What does 'recycle' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Recycle' = 'geri dönüştürmek' – reusing materials to make new products.

questions.stem: Read: 'Last summer, our family went camping. We slept in tents and cooked outside.' What did they use for sleeping?
questions.explanation: The text says 'We slept in tents.'

questions.stem: Which sentence contains a comparative adjective?
options: The blue car is the fastest.
The blue car is faster than the red one.
questions.explanation: 'Faster than' is a comparative adjective comparing two cars.

questions.stem: What is the past tense of 'eat'?
questions.explanation: 'Eat' is irregular. Its past simple form is 'ate'.

questions.stem: Which word is related to computers and the internet?
questions.explanation: Technology is the field that includes computers, internet, and digital devices.

questions.stem: She ___ reading when the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Past Continuous (was/were + -ing) describes an action happening at a specific moment in the past.

questions.stem: What does 'pollution' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Pollution' = 'kirlilik' – the contamination of the environment.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
options: She is more taller than me.
She is the taller than me.
She is most tall than me.
questions.explanation: Comparative of 'tall': 'taller than'. Never use 'more' with -er comparatives.

questions.stem: What question would you ask to find out when something happened?
questions.explanation: 'When' asks about the time an event occurred.

questions.stem: A healthy diet includes fruits, vegetables, and what else?
questions.explanation: A healthy diet needs proteins, vitamins, minerals, and fibre – not just fruits and vegetables.

questions.stem: What does 'ancient' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Ancient' means 'çok eski' – from a very long time ago.

questions.stem: Read: 'Ali spent three hours studying maths and one hour studying science.' How many hours did Ali study in total?
questions.explanation: 3 hours (maths) + 1 hour (science) = 4 hours total.

questions.stem: Which is the correct question form: 'You went to Istanbul ___?'
questions.explanation: Positive past simple sentence → negative question tag with 'didn't': 'didn't you?'

questions.stem: What does 'She was born in 2012.' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Was born' is past tense of 'be born'. The sentence means '2012'de doğdu.'

questions.stem: Which word describes how the weather feels very cold?
questions.explanation: 'Freezing' means extremely cold – much colder than just 'cool'.

questions.stem: What is the superlative of 'bad'?
questions.explanation: 'Bad' has an irregular superlative: 'worst'. ('Bad → worse → worst')

questions.stem: Which sentence describes an action happening RIGHT NOW?
questions.explanation: Present Continuous (am/is/are + -ing) describes actions happening at the moment of speaking.

questions.stem: What does 'endangered species' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Endangered species' = 'tükenmekte olan türler' – animals or plants at risk of extinction.

questions.stem: Write the question: You want to know what sport someone plays. Which question is correct?
questions.explanation: Simple present question: Do/Does + subject + base verb? 'What sport do you play?'

questions.stem: Which word is a synonym for 'happy'?
questions.explanation: 'Joyful' means very happy – it is a synonym for happy.

questions.stem: He has lived in Ankara ___ five years.
questions.explanation: 'For' is used with a period/duration of time: 'for five years'.

questions.stem: Which option correctly completes: 'Mount Everest is ___ mountain in the world.'?
questions.explanation: Superlative: 'the + adjective + -est'. 'The highest mountain.'

questions.stem: What does 'earthquake' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Earthquake' = 'deprem' – shaking of the earth's surface.

questions.stem: Read: 'The Blue Mosque was built in the 1600s. It has six minarets.' When was it built?
questions.explanation: The text directly states 'built in the 1600s.'

questions.stem: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Third person singular negative: doesn't + base verb. 'She doesn't like coffee.'

questions.stem: What does 'destination' mean in Turkish?
questions.explanation: 'Destination' = 'varış yeri / hedef' – the place you are travelling to.

questions.stem: Which phrase means 'in the past'?
questions.explanation: 'Long ago' means something happened far back in time – in the past.

questions.stem: What is the past tense of 'write'?
questions.explanation: 'Write' is irregular: past simple is 'wrote'. ('Write → wrote → written')

questions.stem: He is ___ his bike in the park at the moment.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous: is + verb-ing. 'He is riding his bike.'

questions.stem: Which word is an adjective?
questions.explanation: 'Beautiful' is an adjective – it describes a noun.

questions.stem: Complete: 'Hurry up! We ___ late.'
questions.explanation: 'We' takes 'are': 'We are late.'

questions.stem: What does 'protect the environment' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Protect' = 'korumak'. 'Protect the environment' = 'çevreyi korumak'.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct for Past Simple?
options: I go to the cinema yesterday.
I went to the cinema yesterday.
I was go to the cinema.
questions.explanation: Past simple of 'go' is 'went'. 'I went to the cinema yesterday.'

questions.stem: What does the prefix 'un-' mean in 'unhappy'?
questions.explanation: The prefix 'un-' means 'not'. 'Unhappy' = 'not happy'.

questions.stem: Read: 'Tom is the fastest runner in his class. He trains every day after school.' Why is Tom the fastest?
questions.explanation: The text says he 'trains every day after school' – this explains why he is the fastest.

questions.stem: Which phrase means you want to know someone's opinion?
questions.explanation: 'What do you think?' asks for someone's opinion or view.

questions.stem: Which is the correct spelling of the past tense of 'stop'?
questions.explanation: Short verbs ending in consonant-vowel-consonant (CVC) double the last consonant: stop → stopped.

questions.stem: What does 'solar energy' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Solar' relates to the sun. 'Solar energy' = 'güneş enerjisi'.

questions.stem: Which sentence uses 'were' correctly?
questions.explanation: 'Were' is used with you, we, they, and plural subjects. 'They were tired.'

questions.stem: What is the antonym of 'modern'?
questions.explanation: 'Ancient' is the opposite of 'modern' – it means very old.

questions.stem: What is the correct order: 'yesterday / she / studied / English'?
questions.explanation: Correct order: Subject + Verb + Object + Time. 'She studied English yesterday.'

questions.stem: Which word describes something that is not real?
questions.explanation: 'Imaginary' means existing only in the imagination – not real.

questions.stem: Complete: '___ were you doing when I called you?'
questions.explanation: 'What were you doing?' asks about the action someone was performing.

questions.stem: What does 'donate' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Donate' = 'bağış yapmak' – to give something (money, goods) to help others.

questions.stem: Which sentence correctly uses a superlative?
options: She is the most tall girl.
questions.explanation: One-syllable adjectives: the + adjective + -est. 'The tallest girl.'

questions.stem: What does 'astronaut' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Astronaut' = 'astronot' – a person trained to travel in space.

questions.stem: What tense is used in: 'We are visiting the museum tomorrow.'?
questions.explanation: Present Continuous can be used for definite future plans: 'We are visiting...tomorrow.'

questions.stem: Read: 'In Turkey, you can find ancient ruins, beautiful beaches and delicious food.' What THREE things are mentioned?
questions.explanation: The text explicitly mentions 'ancient ruins, beautiful beaches and delicious food'.

questions.stem: Which word means a person who designs buildings?
questions.explanation: An 'architect' is a professional who plans and designs buildings.

questions.stem: What does 'She hasn't finished yet.' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Hasn't finished yet' = 'henüz bitirmedi' – the action is not complete up to now.

questions.stem: Which word is a conjunction?
questions.explanation: 'However' is a conjunction/connector used to show contrast between two ideas.

questions.stem: What does 'volunteer' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Volunteer' = 'gönüllü' – a person who works for free to help others.

questions.stem: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Ali was more cleverer than Mehmet.
Ali is more cleverer than Mehmet.
Ali is the more clever than Mehmet.
questions.explanation: 'Clever' forms comparative with -er: 'cleverer than'. Never use 'more' with -er comparatives.
